% LIST OF SYMBOLS
\chapter*{LIST OF SYMBOLS}
\addcontentsline{toc}{chapter}{LIST OF SYMBOLS}

\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.18\textwidth}p{0.72\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Symbol} & \textbf{Description} \\
\midrule
\endfirsthead
\toprule
\textbf{Symbol} & \textbf{Description} \\
\midrule
\endhead
\bottomrule
\endfoot

\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Greek letters}} \\
$\theta$ & Elevation angle (degrees) \\
$\theta_a$ & Elevation angle at azimuth $a$ \\
$\theta_{\max}$ & Maximum elevation angle along a ray \\
$\alpha$ & Azimuth angle (degrees) \\
$\beta_c$ & Elevation angle at column $c$ \\
$\delta$ & Sub-pixel offset, azimuth bin size, or curvature drop \\
$\Delta d$ & Ray-trace step size (30\,m) \\
$\sigma$ & Gaussian standard deviation or noise level \\
$\varepsilon$ & Small constant ($10^{-6}$) to avoid division by zero \\
$\phi_y$ & Vertical field of view (degrees) \\
$\phi_x$ & Horizontal field of view (degrees) \\
$\Phi$ & Angular coverage of a fused profile (degrees) \\
$\Theta$ & Fused 360$^\circ$ elevation profile \\
\midrule

\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Calligraphic}} \\
$\mathcal{L}$ & Combined loss function \\
$\mathcal{L}_{\text{BCE}}$ & Binary cross-entropy loss \\
$\mathcal{L}_{\text{Dice}}$ & Soft Dice loss \\
\midrule

\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Estimated values}} \\
$\hat{p}_i$ & Predicted sky probability for pixel $i$ \\
$y_i$ & Ground-truth label for pixel $i$ (1 = sky, 0 = terrain) \\
\midrule

\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Latin letters}} \\
$N$ & Number of azimuth bins (720) \\
$K$ & Number of bins in a partial profile \\
$C$ & Number of crop images \\
$W$ & Image width (pixels) \\
$H$ & Image height (pixels) \\
$h_t$ & Terrain elevation at sample point (metres) \\
$h_o$ & Observer eye height above terrain (1.6\,m) \\
$d_a$ & Horizontal distance along ray at azimuth $a$ (metres) \\
$f_x$ & Horizontal focal length (pixels) \\
$f_y$ & Vertical focal length (pixels) \\
$R_E$ & Earth's radius ($\approx 6371$\,km) \\
$k$ & RRF rank constant (60) or filter kernel size \\
$s$ & Coarse scan stride (12) \\

\end{longtable}
